en:
They were so young and talented...
How could this happen?

It looked like...an accident. They were running 
away from <CLT=cltSTRONG>that group<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

...Was it really just an accident though?
I honestly can't believe that.

I can't say it too loudly but...they were
probably killed by <CLT=cltSTRONG>that group<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
I thought so.

Oh, no...
Well, there's nothing we can do about that.

I wanted them to live. For our sake,
at least...
Geez...I wish they lived.

No, they should have lived.
They had to.
For this world...
Where you hiding...?
Come out...
No more hiding... Come out now...

Hey! Come out, bugs!
Where you all hiding!?

Just when Gonta think he find some...
They gone.
...Weird. Really weird.

Plenty trees, grass, water, sun...
But no bugs. Why?
Weird... So weird...

If any bugs here, come out!
Gonta wanna talk to you!
Hm?

What that?
Something on ground, in grass...
...Words written on it...?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>*ding dong*
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>*ding dong ding dong ding dong ding dong!*
Ah!

Wh-Who is it!?
Wait, I'm coming, I'm coming!

<CLT=cltMIND>With the doorbell hurrying me along,
I went to open the door...
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>*click*

Hey, what are you doing?
It's already morning!
K-Kaito?
Ah...do you...need something?
Well, yeah! Food!

I was gonna eat breakfast with everyone in the
dining hall, but you weren't there...
That's why I came to get you.
Huh? But...I don't recall making any plans.

You should be at the dining hall, anyway.
I mean, where else are you gonna eat breakfast?
Ah, I don't usually eat breakfast, so...

A-Are you serious? If you don't have breakfast,
then what do you eat in the morning?

Ah, whatever! Let's get going!
The others are waiting!

Ah, wait, I'm not ready!
Let me get my—
...Actually...never mind.
<CLT=cltMIND>I don't need <CLT=cltSTRONG>that<CLT=cltMIND> anymore...
Okay, let's go.
Oh, right... I was gonna tell you...

I-I'm sorry about yesterday...
Y'know, for...slugging you like that.
Huh? Ah, that... It's okay.
I-I see... Then let's go.

The others are waiting, so let's 
go to the dining hall.

<CLT=cltMIND>Why...is Kaito here?
I'll just ask what he wants for now.

<CLT=cltMIND>Why...is Kaito here?
I'll just ask what he wants for now.
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?

<CLT=cltMIND>Why...is Kaito here?
I'll just ask what he wants for now.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's just a monitor. Even if I investigate,
I don't think I'll find anything suspicious...

<CLT=cltMIND>Maybe there's a camera in here,
watching us... Maybe not.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a normal bed.
It was pretty comfortable.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a pretty big light.
And it's pretty bright too...

<CLT=cltMIND>My closet is filled with
uniforms exactly like mine...

<CLT=cltMIND>They went through all this just for a
killing game? What is their objective...?
